newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen staying out of open market Friday.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen staying out of open market Friday.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to remain on the sidelines during its mid-morning open market intervention period, analysts said.

Given the shortened session and the Fed executing both overnight and 6-day fixed system repurchase agreements on Thursday, there is no need for the Fed to add reserves to the banking system, analysts said.
Plus, they added, the Federal funds rate is trading below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target rate at 5-3/16 percent, suggesting no reserve pressures.
U.S. bond markets close at 1400 EST/1900 GMT on Friday and will be closed on Monday in observance of Martin Luther King Jr Day.
